description: This file implements the ModuleConfigurationService interface, providing methods for managing and retrieving module configurations and integration modules, with caching and JSON parsing logic.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing module configurations, utilizing dependency injection, caching, and JSON parsing.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve an IntegrationModule by its unique code from the DAO.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Fetches a list of IntegrationModule objects for a given module name, utilizing cache and parsing JSON strings to populate module details, region sets, and configuration maps.
